en.text: A revelation about Nineveh. The book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite.

zhSimplified.text: 论尼尼微的默示，就是伊勒歌斯人那鸿所得的默示。

zhTraditional.text: 論尼尼微的默示，就是伊勒歌斯人那鴻所得的默示。

en.text: The LORD is a jealous God and avenges. The LORD avenges and is full of wrath. The LORD takes vengeance on his adversaries, and he maintains wrath against his enemies.

footnotes.text: 1:2 When rendered in ALL CAPITAL LETTERS, “LORD” or “GOD” is the translation of God’s Proper Name (Hebrew “יהוה*”, usually pronounced Yahweh).

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华是忌邪施报的 神。 耶和华施报大有忿怒； 向他的敌人施报， 向他的仇敌怀怒。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華是忌邪施報的上帝。 耶和華施報大有忿怒； 向他的敵人施報， 向他的仇敵懷怒。

en.text: The LORD is slow to anger, and great in power, and will by no means leave the guilty unpunished. The LORD has his way in the whirlwind and in the storm, and the clouds are the dust of his feet.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华不轻易发怒，大有能力， 万不以有罪的为无罪。 他乘旋风和暴风而来， 云彩为他脚下的尘土。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華不輕易發怒，大有能力， 萬不以有罪的為無罪。 他乘旋風和暴風而來， 雲彩為他腳下的塵土。

en.text: He rebukes the sea and makes it dry, and dries up all the rivers. Bashan and Carmel languish. The flower of Lebanon languishes.

zhSimplified.text: 他斥责海，使海干了， 使一切江河干涸。 巴珊和迦密的树林衰残； 黎巴嫩的花草也衰残了。

zhTraditional.text: 他斥責海，使海乾了， 使一切江河乾涸。 巴珊和迦密的樹林衰殘； 黎巴嫩的花草也衰殘了。

en.text: The mountains quake before him, and the hills melt away. The earth trembles at his presence, yes, the world, and all who dwell in it.

zhSimplified.text: 大山因他震动； 小山也都消化。 大地在他面前突起； 世界和住在其间的也都如此。

zhTraditional.text: 大山因他震動； 小山也都消化。 大地在他面前突起； 世界和住在其間的也都如此。

en.text: Who can stand before his indignation? Who can endure the fierceness of his anger? His wrath is poured out like fire, and the rocks are broken apart by him.

zhSimplified.text: 他发忿恨，谁能立得住呢？ 他发烈怒，谁能当得起呢？ 他的忿怒如火倾倒； 磐石因他崩裂。

zhTraditional.text: 他發忿恨，誰能立得住呢？ 他發烈怒，誰能當得起呢？ 他的忿怒如火傾倒； 磐石因他崩裂。

en.text: The LORD is good, a stronghold in the day of trouble; and he knows those who take refuge in him.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华本为善， 在患难的日子为人的保障， 并且认得那些投靠他的人。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華本為善， 在患難的日子為人的保障， 並且認得那些投靠他的人。

en.text: But with an overflowing flood, he will make a full end of her place, and will pursue his enemies into darkness.

zhSimplified.text: 但他必以涨溢的洪水淹没尼尼微， 又驱逐仇敌进入黑暗。

zhTraditional.text: 但他必以漲溢的洪水淹沒尼尼微， 又驅逐仇敵進入黑暗。

en.text: What do you plot against the LORD? He will make a full end. Affliction won’t rise up the second time.

zhSimplified.text: 尼尼微人哪，设何谋攻击耶和华呢？ 他必将你们灭绝净尽； 灾难不再兴起。

zhTraditional.text: 尼尼微人哪，設何謀攻擊耶和華呢？ 他必將你們滅絕淨盡； 災難不再興起。

en.text: For entangled like thorns, and drunken as with their drink, they are consumed utterly like dry stubble.

zhSimplified.text: 你们像丛杂的荆棘， 像喝醉了的人， 又如枯干的碎秸全然烧灭。

zhTraditional.text: 你們像叢雜的荊棘， 像喝醉了的人， 又如枯乾的碎稭全然燒滅。

en.text: One has gone out of you who devises evil against the LORD, who counsels wickedness.

zhSimplified.text: 有一人从你那里出来， 图谋邪恶，设恶计攻击耶和华。

zhTraditional.text: 有一人從你那裏出來， 圖謀邪惡，設惡計攻擊耶和華。

en.text: The LORD says: “Though they are in full strength and likewise many, even so they will be cut down and pass away. Though I have afflicted you, I will afflict you no more.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华如此说： 尼尼微虽然势力充足，人数繁多， 也被剪除，归于无有。 犹大啊，我虽然使你受苦， 却不再使你受苦。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華如此說： 尼尼微雖然勢力充足，人數繁多， 也被剪除，歸於無有。 猶大啊，我雖然使你受苦， 卻不再使你受苦。

en.text: Now I will break his yoke from off you, and will burst your bonds apart.”

zhSimplified.text: 现在我必从你颈项上折断他的轭， 扭开他的绳索。

zhTraditional.text: 現在我必從你頸項上折斷他的軛， 扭開他的繩索。

en.text: The LORD has commanded concerning you: “No more descendants will bear your name. Out of the house of your gods, I will cut off the engraved image and the molten image. I will make your grave, for you are vile.”

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华已经出令，指着尼尼微说： 你名下的人必不留后； 我必从你神的庙中除灭雕刻的偶像和铸造的偶像； 我必因你鄙陋，使你归于坟墓。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華已經出令，指着尼尼微說： 你名下的人必不留後； 我必從你神的廟中除滅雕刻的偶像和鑄造的偶像； 我必因你鄙陋，使你歸於墳墓。

en.text: Behold,on the mountains the feet of him who brings good news, who publishes peace! Keep your feasts, Judah! Perform your vows, for the wicked one will no more pass through you. He is utterly cut off.

footnotes.text: 1:15 “Behold”, from “הִנֵּה*”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection.

zhSimplified.text: 看哪，有报好信传平安之人的脚登山，说： 犹大啊，可以守你的节期， 还你所许的愿吧！ 因为那恶人不再从你中间经过， 他已灭绝净尽了。

zhTraditional.text: 看哪，有報好信傳平安之人的腳登山，說： 猶大啊，可以守你的節期， 還你所許的願吧！ 因為那惡人不再從你中間經過， 他已滅絕淨盡了。
